title: Dual differential polarimetry. A technique to recover polarimetric information from dual-polarization observations
question: Can polarimetric information of resolved sources be recovered from dual-polarization (XX, YY only) interferometric data using Earth-rotation synthesis of the parallactic angle?

what.value: CASA Guide 3C286 polarization results (p = 0.1645 ± 0.0002, angle 38.30 ± 0.02 deg) used as comparison

evidence.loc: 4 Test with ALMA Science Verification data
evidence.quote: which is similar to the one reported in the CASA Guide ($p = 0.1645  \pm  0.0002$)

external_data.citation: CASA Guide; Nagai et al. 2016 (cite: Nagai)

what.value: PKS 1830-211 ALMA data and RM results of earlier paper, reanalysed

evidence.quote: In Fig. [7](#NEWSCI) we show the results of a reanalysis of the data reported in (cite: Science), but using the correct feed angles.

what.value: Beam squint estimates from ALMA Memo 362 Table VI

evidence.quote: estimates of the beam squint (although in a circular polarization basis) are given in (cite: ALMA362) (Table VI)

recipe.method: CLEAN deconvolution of full dataset without polarization calibration

recipe.goal: Fit component fluxes per scan in XX and YY
recipe.method: Visibility fitting of fixed-position CLEAN components, only flux densities free, per parallactic angle scan

recipe.goal: Compute Rpol and fit sinusoid vs parallactic angle
recipe.method: Compute Rpol per pixel relative to fiducial source element and fit Rpol = pdif cos(2(phi-alpha-psi))
assumptions: Short baselines so parallactic angle is same for all antennas; for 3C 286, constant gain amplitude ratio and Ceres unpolarized

evidence.loc: 4 Test with ALMA Science Verification data
4 Test with ALMA Science Verification data
evidence.quote: we obtain a source polarization angle of $\phi = 37.04 \pm 0.12$ deg.

not_stated_but_needed: CLEAN parameters (niter, threshold, masks) for simulations and 3C 286
Scan/time binning used to define constant parallactic angle
Details of the fit initial values and uncertainties for the PKS 1830-211 reanalysis
Corrected feed angles and spectral windows/epochs used in reanalysis
score_reason: Public SV data and clear equations, but CLEAN and scan settings are missing and the simulation code is not released.
rediscovery_reason: The SV data are public, the recipe is mostly clear, and the results are numeric (p and phi of 3C 286).
